source_summary.auth: Token required; API users are separately permissioned by module/method; IP restriction is available; API console exists.
source_summary.order: order2/createOrders + order query surface documents OrderId, OrderCode, OrderDate, OrderStatusId, OrderTotalPrice, Currency, customer and order-line fields.
source_summary.inventory: Merchant stock settings explicitly control negative-stock selling, real-stock sold-out behavior and payment-time stock decrement timing.
source_summary.webhook: POST webhook, JSON/form content, optional Secret Key sent through X-Hub-Signature; HTTP failures are queued for resend; exact signature algorithm not admitted.

mappings.note: Provider numeric order ID preserved as provider-scoped string.
Customer/operator-visible order reference.
Documented YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS requires explicit timezone/source interpretation before UtcTimestamp.
Preserve provider status identifier; do not invent generic lifecycle semantics.
Amount parsing/minor-unit conversion required; documented TL code must be explicitly mapped to ISO-style TRY rather than passed directly.
Documented as customer email; provider readability does not grant disclosure or customer binding.
PII display requires authorized tenant/customer context.
Order line uses T-Soft product stock/web-service code; adapter must resolve it to internal ProductId within the integration.
Quantity requires integer/bigint parse only.
Documented as unit selling price; lineTotalMoney requires unit price x quantity and currency evidence.
Carrier assignment evidence is not equivalent to an actual shipment/tracking record; map only when shipment context exists.
Web-service code is unique but can be administratively changed; prefer immutable provider ID if exposed in the exact API. Do not silently treat mutable code as canonical provider identity.
Sub-product code exists but exact immutable variant ID/read schema is not admitted in this bounded capture.
Stock behavior is documented, but an exact read-side stock API field/payload was not admitted in this bounded mapping evidence.
Maps to ALLOW_SELLING_WITHOUT_POSITIVE_QUANTITY when exact merchant setting evidence is current.
Maps to REQUIRE_POSITIVE_QUANTITY when exact merchant setting evidence is current.
Payment workflow affects when stock reflects pending orders; freshness/interpretation must account for payment/order state rather than treating quantity as immediate truth.
Can be derived only when relevant stock-policy settings and storefront/product state are known; numeric quantity alone is insufficient.
Signature header and secret key are documented, but exact algorithm/canonicalization are not admitted. Fail closed until verified.
Provider queues failed HTTP deliveries; internal idempotency/replay handling remains mandatory.
Tenant/integration authority must come from server-side registered endpoint/integration binding, never from arbitrary payload content.

critical_findings: Current Order model fits T-Soft order identity/reference/status/total semantics, but timestamp timezone and TL->TRY currency normalization require explicit adapter rules.
T-Soft stock settings independently validate the normalized contract's separation of quantity from inventory policy and customer-visible sellability.
Current customer-verification boundary is required because T-Soft order data exposes customer name/email fields but provider readability is not disclosure authority.
Current webhook ingress design is appropriately stricter than the public T-Soft docs: X-Hub-Signature existence is not enough to admit authenticity without the exact verification algorithm.
Product/variant identity remains a bounded mapping gap because mutable web-service codes should not be silently promoted to immutable provider IDs.
No core contract expansion is required by the bounded T-Soft E2 evidence. Adapter identity/currency/time/policy/signature rules remain the material gaps.
open_gates: Exact read-side product/variant API schema with immutable IDs and option fields
OrderDate timezone semantics and update timestamp fields
Authenticated readback and post-write reconciliation for any future mutation
